description: The bar chart, titled "Health and Nutrition," "Logistics," and "Travel and Transportation," illustrates the proportion of variance explained by two components—MVS (green) and 1-MVS (blue)—across different LLMs (70B llama and 8B llama) in three distinct domains. The horizontal axis displays the LLMs and their respective domains, while the vertical axis represents the proportion of variance, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. In the "Health and Nutrition" domain, the 70B llama model shows a higher MVS component (approximately 0.6) compared to the 8B llama (approximately 0.4), with the 1-MVS component making up the remainder. In the "Logistics" domain, the 70B llama model again shows a higher MVS component (approximately 0.5) compared to the 8B llama (approximately 0.4), with the 1-MVS component making up the remainder. In the "Travel and Transportation" domain, the 70B llama model shows a higher MVS component (approximately 0.4) compared to the 8B llama (approximately 0.4), with the 1-MVS component making up the remainder. The legend indicates that the green bars represent the MVS component and the blue bars represent the 1-MVS component. The chart suggests that the 70B llama model generally explains a higher proportion of variance in the MVS component across all domains compared to the 8B llama model.
